insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for an unfulfilled order. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update is effective as of September 9, 2026.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware that taxes will be recalculated when the shipping address is changed. This may impact order totals and should be considered when implementing order updates. No migration is required, but testing order updates with address changes is recommended to ensure compatibility. The GraphQL Admin API is affected, specifically the orderUpdate mutation.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations for orders with updated shipping addresses, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and avoiding potential discrepancies.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid financial losses and ensure compliance with tax laws. This update enhances the reliability of the orderUpdate mutation and benefits merchants by providing precise tax calculations.

also_worth_knowing.text: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience. This update includes other minor changes and bug fixes.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and customizable cart management. The updateCart standard action now updates cart attributes.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, consolidating how in-progress inventory holds are represented. This change aims to improve inventory management.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores. Agents can search catalogs, manage carts, and initiate checkout.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores. Note that development stores don't include public environments.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing for more flexible order fulfillment management. Developers can attach multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, with new thresholds that better reflect fulfillment operations. These changes aim to make Built for Shopify more achievable for developers.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated, adding new capabilities to the toolkit and extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts. Vue bindings are now available, allowing developers to build storefronts in Vue with the same Hydrogen API.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities. These changes aim to improve cash management for merchants.

CLI version 4.6.0 includes several changes, such as removing deprecated draftable extension processes and dev session support branching. New flags have been added to avoid prompts in app config linking.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making when approving requests. This change aims to improve trust and security for collaborator access.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance campaign insights, UI extensions, and storefront events

themes.title: ShopifyQL Enhancements
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. The shop_campaign_insights schema is now available in ShopifyQL.

themes.title: Development Tooling Updates
themes.detail: The Shopify CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which includes serving UI extension source maps during app development. This update improves the development experience for UI extensions.

themes.title: Storefront API Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management. The updateCart standard action now updates cart attributes, and a new shopify:cart:attributes-update event fires whenever an attributes update is initiated.
